'''Varen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] and citizen of the [[Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] he resisded at the [[Koss Overlook]] in the [[Gormak Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], he asked a Republic individual for assistance.
